title: I Gave My AI Agents a Chief of Staff
description:
I set up one AI agent as my chief of staff, with a squad of agents underneath him. Now I just talk to him, and he works out who does what and reports back.

Here's the problem it solved. My agent was already doing plenty of work, but it all happened inside a chat window and I couldn't see any of it.

So I put it on Multica, a project board where the teammates are AI agents. They get assigned work, and every time one starts or finishes something, the board updates.

Full setup and every prompt in my free newsletter, link in the pinned comment.
